description: Install one starter pack from list_packs into the global lexicon (or the project .lexicon.yaml with scope: project; a project file that is not trusted yet is left untrusted, `trusted: false`: relay `nextStep`). Adds the pack's terms with source "pack"; a term the user already has keeps its own spelling and aliases and only gains the pack's. Idempotent. A pack adds dozens of terms (list_packs gives each pack's `terms` count), so name the pack and its size and ask before calling this. Remove one later with `lexicon pack remove <name>` (or `npx @ashlr/lexicon pack remove <name>`). For a community pack, pass name as <author>/<name> with registry pointing at the index: without confirm the tool returns the full term-list preview and writes nothing (show it to the user first); with confirm: true it installs after they approved. A vendored pack installs directly: registry, previewDigest or confirm: false with one is refused and nothing is written. Community installs pin the checksum, so `lexicon pack update` (or `npx @ashlr/lexicon pack update`) re-checks it later.

confirm.description: Community packs only: true = install after the user approved the preview. Omit/false = preview only, write nothing. A vendored pack has no preview: confirm: false with one is refused.

name.description: Pack name from list_packs (e.g. developer) or a community ref like example/cardiology; must not be blank. A pack name is 1 to 64 lowercase letters, digits and dashes, starting with a letter or digit; a community ref is <author>/<name>, the author 1 to 39 of the same characters, optionally followed by @<version> (up to 32 characters). Anything else is refused.

previewDigest.description: Community packs only: digest returned by the approved full-content preview; required with confirm. Refused with a vendored pack.

registry.description: Registry index for community packs, as the user gave it: only an index the user registered is read (one they installed a pack from with the CLI, or one in LEXICON_REGISTRIES); any other is refused, and so is a blank one. Omit for the vendored starter packs only. Required for community refs.

name: add_pack
title: Install a starter term pack
